component.name: Skylands Untrapped
component.summary: Native PC runtime for Skylanders Trap Team

description.p: Skylands Untrapped is a fan-made native PC port and reimplementation of Skylanders Trap Team with support for hardware Traptanium portals, software portal emulation, modern graphics, and input mappings.
Requires a legally acquired European Wii disc or WBFS image (rom.eu.wbfs) to extract game assets on first run.
